title: Myth Flip — AI won't diagnose you, it preps your page
caption:
Myth: AI will diagnose you. It won't. But it can turn a year of phone notes into one dated page your doctor can read fast. Doctors interrupt after ~11 seconds (JGIM, 2019). Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #aiforwomen #patientadvocacy #womensmentalhealth #healthmyths

scenes.text: Myth: “*AI* will diagnose me.” It won't. What it will do is hand your doctor one dated page.
scenes.suggest: → Ask AI for a *dated symptom page* (JGIM 2019)

scenes.text: For *two years* she heard the same lines, so she stopped bringing it up.
phrases: I had 14 months of notes in my phone.
I said “I'm just tired” and went home.

scenes.text: Reena, 38, pasted fourteen months of phone notes into an *AI* and asked it to sort by date.
phrases: Fourteen months of notes, zero order.
She asked AI to sort it by date and find the pattern.
Back came one page: heaviest days, worst sleep nights, three questions.

scenes.text: Ask AI for one *dated page*, then write your three questions at the top before you go.
phrases: 1. Ask AI: sort my notes by date, one page.
2. At the top, your 3 questions — what is my main problem, what do I do, why it matters.
3. Add sleep and movement to the page; WHO's baseline is 150 minutes a week.
